title: Don’t move the mouth! 🤐 #westend #broadway #musicaltheatre
transcript: Hey theatre fans, can we agree to just zip it about the thing that was just announced? Cause good lord, have we all just forgotten the lost art of gatekeeping? And if you don't know what I'm talking about right now, don't worry about it. None of your business. Keep scrolling now that they're gone. And jokes aside, I guess, although I was only kind of joking, I have been saying for years that there maybe is such a thing as theatre news that is too exciting. I've said this in the past when people have talked about like, you know, would Taylor Swift for example, ever come to Broadway? And I have said “dear god I hope not.” Not because I wouldn't love to see that personally, but I think there's a point at which the limited infrastructure of theatre Is so unequipped to handle the demand for something that I wonder if it's even worth it. And yeah, Taylor Swift is a somewhat more extreme example than we're talking about now, but functionally not that different in terms of the infrastructure problem I'm talking about. Cause like, at what point does it go from being an exclusive sold out show and a financial windfall to being a genuine strain on the system? Something like this kind of feels like the Infinity Gauntlet or the One Ring. Like as much as we are tempted to see it as a force for good, it. It might just be a little bit Too powerful for us. I don't know that humanity is quite able to handle it
